vouches.quote: Inspected CampusCart repo and live telemetry. The clean separation between React Server Components and their FastAPI microservice is on par with L4 industry standards. I vouch for their backend and frontend leads for direct MNC interviews.

Their 7-day turnaround from our async roast feedback was phenomenal. They fixed the SQL connection pooling and cut P99 latency by 60%. Ready to acqui-hire or assign paid freelance modules immediately.

roasts.feedback: Watch out for database connection pooling under high peak dinner rushes (9 PM to 11 PM). Use PgBouncer or switch to Supabase connection pooling before hostel 8 opens.
Mobile checkout drawer closes abruptly if user scrolls horizontally on Android. Add touch-action: pan-y to prevent gesture conflicts.
